name: bijux_dev_help
stdout:
Usage: bijux dev [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Developer tools and diagnostics.

Options:
  -q, --quiet             Suppress normal output; exit code still indicates
                          success/failure.
  -f, --format TEXT       Machine-readable output format (json|yaml); defaults
                          to json.  [default: json]
  --pretty / --no-pretty  Disable pretty-printing (indentation) in JSON/YAML
                          output.  [default: pretty]
  --log-level TEXT        Set logging level (trace|debug|info). Example:
                          --log-level debug.  [default: info]
  -h, --help              Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  di             Generates and outputs the Dependency Injection (DI)...
  list-products  List product binaries and resolved paths.
  list-plugins   Lists all installed CLI plugins.
  atlas          Bijux Atlas control-plane developer commands.
